messages:
Mara: Heads up — we're seeing onboarding stalls for a subset of private VPC customers that hit our webhook delivery during provisioning. Customers see the UX stuck at 'finalizing' and onboarding tasks never complete. Not widespread but several priority accounts affected.

Jules: Which customers and how many? Do we have an estimate of rollout window?

Mara: Right now 7 accounts across EU and US regions. First reports ~08:12 this morning. Spike in failures at 08:10–08:25. Symptoms: webhook 401/403 returned from customer endpoints.

Sam: Reproduced locally — a token-rotation change in last night's auth library (release v3.2.1) can, in rare timing, swap the key while the provisioning webhook is in-flight, which makes our signature invalid. Logs show `signature_mismatch` followed by `403` for those request IDs.

Kevin: Confirmed. We shipped a small ordering change to the rotation handler. Rollback to previous behavior pushed to staging at 09:05, rollout to prod started at 09:30. We've queued a canary to affected regions. ops-bot: deployment rollback to v3.2.0 in progress (canary).

ops-bot: Rollback to v3.2.0 initiated by Kevin at 09:30. Canary 1/3 success, 2/3 running.

Priya: From CS side we need a concise customer note — status, scope, ETA, and mitigation steps. Also propose offering 1 month of onboarding credits + an invite to a live troubleshooting hour for high-touch accounts.

Riley: Draft external line to customers (short): "We're investigating an issue that can cause onboarding to stall during final provisioning for some customers on private VPCs. Engineers identified a token rotation regression in a recent release; we have initiated a rollback and expect full recovery in the next 60 minutes. We'll follow up with an RCA and next steps. If you're impacted and want immediate help, reply to this thread or open a ticket and we will prioritize." Thoughts?

Mara: Good start. Add explicit mitigations: (1) Restart the onboarding job in the console (manual retry) — that will succeed post-rollback, (2) If customers have custom endpoints, they can temporarily allow the old signing key for ~10 minutes while we complete rollback. But be careful — we shouldn't ask customers to change security posture for long.

Jules: I'll get a list of the 7 accounts + primary contacts and priority level. Can we push a short templated note for them and a personalized ping for the top 3?

Sam: Also grabbing the relevant request IDs and a paste of the error lines to attach to each ticket: e.g., `request_id=abc123: signature_mismatch -> 403`. That helps their infra teams correlate.

Priya: I'll prepare the customer-facing email + in-app banner copy. Proposed banner: "Onboarding operations disrupted for some private VPC customers. Engineers have rolled back a recent update; most impacted customers should see normal progress within 60 minutes. For expedited assistance, click 'Request help' or reply to your onboarding thread."

Kevin: Canary finished: ops-bot reports rollback completed to v3.2.0 across EU + US at 09:46. We're still watching KV cache volatility for ~15m. Past logs show failures drop to baseline after rollback.

ops-bot: Rollback completed at 09:46. Post-rollback healthchecks passing in EU/US.

Riley: Updated draft to customers with ETA changed to "expected recovery within 60 minutes; full verification complete" and added the bullet list of immediate steps Mara suggested. I'll paste templated message below for review: \n\n---\nHi — we identified an issue causing onboarding to stall for some customers on private VPCs. Engineers have rolled back a recent auth change and most accounts should resume provisioning within the next hour.\n\nWhat you can do now:\n• In the Redwood Console: go to Onboarding → click Retry on the stalled job.\n• If you manage custom webhook endpoints: if your team is able to temporarily accept the previous signing key for ~10 minutes while we finish verification, that will avoid manual retries (optional).\n\nWe will follow up with a detailed RCA and any credits where applicable. If you want immediate assistance, reply here or open a priority ticket and we will move you to the front of the queue.\n\nThanks for your patience — Riley on behalf of Redwood CS\n---\n

Mara: Looks good. For the top 3 enterprise customers we should also offer a 1:1 troubleshooting session and a phone bridge. Priya, can you own scheduling if they accept?

Priya: Yep. I'll prepare calendar invites and include our SRE on the bridge. Also capturing feedback post-resolve.

Jules: I'll start outreach now to the 7 contacts with the templated note and a personalized line for top 3. Posting the outreach plan to the account doc after messages go out.

Sam: Followup for RCAs — I'm collecting the stack traces and request IDs. Will attach anonymized examples to the RCA. Also will include the mitigation steps and the exact commit that caused the regression: `commit 5d3b7e4`.

Kevin: Action items for infra: (1) revert rotation ordering permanently, (2) add a short-circuit to accept last-known key for in-flight requests for 30s, (3) add a test covering token rotation race. I'll create tickets.

Mara: Thanks everyone. After outreach is sent, please ping me with timestamps. We'll compile a single exec summary for the affected accounts + an RCA draft for customers by EOD.

Jules: Outreach started — first three sent. Updating account doc now.

Priya: Scheduling note — offering a post-incident enablement workshop (30m) next week to any affected customer who wants it. Will include best practices for webhook validation and retry patterns.

Mara: Excellent. Closing loop: once we have the RCA and customer-accepted credit decisions, we will follow-up in-thread and close the tickets. Great fast work. :thumbsup:
